title: Cargo Zigbuild Executor
description: Build one Linux binary or cdylib with devenv's zig through `cargo-zigbuild` and copy it to its output file.

target.description: Rust target triple, with cargo-zigbuild's glibc suffix where it pins one, e.g. x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.2.17 or x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.

manifestPath.description: The crate's Cargo.toml, relative to the workspace root.

bin.description: Build this binary and copy its executable. Absent, build the package's cdylib.

output.description: Destination file for the artifact, relative to the workspace root.

release.description: Compile cargo's release profile instead of dev.
